fact: 1929年，在约翰·朔贝尔领导的奥地利政府压力下，维也纳最大的银行安斯塔特信贷银行（Creditanstalt）收购了陷入困境的同业奥地利博登信贷银行（Allgemeine Bodencreditanstalt）；后者自身是被两年前（1927年）对奥地利联合银行（Unionbank）的收购拖垮的。这笔交易发生在华尔街崩盘前后，把一个已经资不抵债的资产负债表并入奥地利最大的银行。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Creditanstalt（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: In 1929, just at the time of Wall Street crash and under pressure from the Austrian government led by Johann Schober, Creditanstalt purchased its distressed peer the Allgemeine Bodencreditanstalt, which itself was dragged down by its acquisition of Austria's Unionbank two years earlier.

fact: 1931年5月11日，安斯塔特信贷银行宣布无法公布1930年度财务报表，立即引发挤兑恐慌。当时该行占奥地利银行业总资产的27%，相当于全国GDP的16%，因此已没有更大的银行可以像1927年处理联合银行、1929年处理博登信贷银行那样把它吸收掉。总理奥托·恩德组织救助，由奥地利政府、奥地利国家银行与罗斯柴尔德家族分担成本，并拒绝了社会民主党主张的国有化方案；该集团的外国资产被转移至摩纳哥注册的Société Continentale de Gestion。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Creditanstalt（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: the Creditanstalt declared on 11 May 1931 that it was unable to publish its financial statements for 1930, immediately triggering panic. At that time, it represented 27 percent of the Austrian banking sector's total assets, a sum equivalent to 16 percent of the country's GDP, so that there was no option to have it absorbed by another larger banks as had been done with Unionbank in 1927 and Bodencreditanstalt in 1929. ... Chancellor Otto Ender organized a rescue that entailed cost-sharing by the Austrian government, the Oesterreichische Nationalbank, and the Rothschild family, rejecting nationalization plans advocated by the Social Democratic Party.

fact: 1931年奥地利试图与德国缔结关税同盟以改善经济，被法国与小协约国（捷克斯洛伐克、罗马尼亚、南斯拉夫）否决。这一否决发生在安斯塔特信贷银行倒闭之后数月，切断了奥地利通过区域市场自救的路径，也加深了维也纳对国际联盟与西方贷款的依赖。

sources.title: Wikipedia, First Austrian Republic（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: The Great Depression hit Austria hard, and in May 1931 the largest bank in Austria, Creditanstalt Bank, collapsed. To improve its economy, Austria wanted to conclude a customs union with Germany, but in 1931 this was denied by France and the countries of the Little Entente.

fact: 奥地利第一共和国的经济基础极薄：内陆国几乎无法自给粮食，缺乏发达工业；建国初期捷克斯洛伐克、匈牙利、南斯拉夫与意大利对其实施贸易封锁、拒绝出售粮食与煤炭。1922年1美元兑19000克朗，全国半数人口失业；1924年12月先令取代克朗，此前1923年已重建奥地利国家银行并开征销售税。这些是1929年维也纳生活成本的结构性背景：一个没有殖民腹地、没有出海口、工业与粮食都依赖进口的城市共和国。

sources.title: Wikipedia, First Austrian Republic（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: The landlocked Austria was barely able to support itself with food, and lacked a developed industrial basis. In addition, Czechoslovakia, Hungary, Yugoslavia and Italy had imposed a trade blockade and refused to sell food and coal to Austria ... By 1922 one US dollar was worth 19,000 Kronen and half the population was unemployed. ... In 1923, Austria's central bank Oesterreichische Nationalbank was re-established and a sales tax was introduced, and in December 1924 the Austrian schilling replaced the Krone.

fact: 1922年10月，英国、法国、意大利与捷克斯洛伐克向奥地利提供6.5亿金克朗贷款，条件是奥地利承诺此后20年不谋求与德国合并（Anschluss），并允许国际联盟监督其经济。财政的国际监督直到1926年3月才结束。这意味着1929年的奥地利在主权上受外部约束：财政、货币与外交选择都被1922年协定与后续的赔款/贷款安排锁定。

sources.title: Wikipedia, First Austrian Republic（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: In October 1922 Britain, France, Italy and Czechoslovakia provided a loan of 650 million gold Kronen after Seipel promised not to attempt Anschluss with Germany for the next 20 years and allowed the League of Nations to control Austria's economy. During the next two years the state budget was stabilized and international supervision of finances ended in March 1926.

fact: 维也纳银行业在1927—1929年连续完成两次「以大吞小」的救援式合并：1927年联合银行被博登信贷银行吸收，1929年博登信贷银行被安斯塔特信贷银行吸收。两次合并都把问题资产并入更大的资产负债表，而不是清理损失；到1931年5月，安斯塔特信贷银行已占银行业总资产27%，再无可吸收者。这条链条说明：在1929年，维也纳的银行风险不是分散的，而是层层向上集中的。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Creditanstalt（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: it represented 27 percent of the Austrian banking sector's total assets, a sum equivalent to 16 percent of the country's GDP, so that there was no option to have it absorbed by another larger banks as had been done with Unionbank in 1927 and Bodencreditanstalt in 1929.

fact: 奥地利的工业与金融结构继承自哈布斯堡帝国，但帝国解体后重要的经济区域被新国家边界切走：维也纳的银行仍被这些新国家依赖，业务却被新设的边界与关税阻隔。安斯塔特信贷银行在1919年后被迫出售捷克、卢布尔雅那与波兰的分支，1926年又买下英奥银行的维也纳业务（该行因英格兰银行注资而成英国银行，英格兰银行因此通过其子行成为安斯塔特信贷银行的重要股东）。这是1929年维也纳作为「中欧金融中心」的真实含义：网络仍在，腹地已失。

sources.title: Wikipedia, First Austrian Republic（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: The new state was difficult to control, as much of the former empire's important economic regions had been taken away with the foundation of new nation-states. The matter was further complicated because a number of these new nation-states were still dependent on Vienna's banks, but business was hampered by the newly erected borders and tariffs.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Creditanstalt（镜像 us-wikipedia.com）
sources.quote: In 1926, it purchased the Viennese operations of the Anglo-Austrian Bank which had become a British bank following recapitalisation by the Bank of England; since that transaction was structured as an exchange of shares, the Bank of England, through its British subsidiary the Anglo-International Bank, became a significant shareholder of Creditanstalt.
